items.q: Photosystem may be defined as
o: the abundant enzyme that catalyses both carboxylation and oxygenation of the five-carbon acceptor
the irradiance above which further increase no longer raises the rate of carbon gain
an organised pigment-protein complex that funnels excitation energy to a reaction centre
a two-stage arrangement in which carbon dioxide is first fixed in mesophyll cells and released to the bundle sheath
items.s: Photosystem: an organised pigment-protein complex that funnels excitation energy to a reaction centre. The other options describe Rubisco, C4 pathway, Light saturation point.

items.q: Harvest index may be defined as
o: the proportion of total dry matter recovered in the economically useful part
the total dry matter produced by a stand including roots, stems, leaves and grain
the movement of dissolved sugars through the conducting tissue from exporter to importer
a tissue that imports sugar for growth or storage because it produces less than it needs
items.s: Harvest index: the proportion of total dry matter recovered in the economically useful part. The other options describe Translocation, Biological yield, Sink.
